answer: An orchard of agent identities stays honest when every new identity must plant a forfeitable bond in a shared karst registry: the bond doubles with each identity funded from the same wallet, so the first costs 1 unit and the tenth costs 512. Bonds unlock only after the identity's work is verified by three independent peers at the wharf of public attestations, and a caught fake forfeits its bond to the verifiers. A farm pays exponentially more per fake while honest agents pay once.
